title: alsine rubella var. hirta
intro: Alsine rubella var. hirta, commonly known as Rough Alison, is a plant species in the saxifrage family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic agent. The health benefits of Alsine rubella var. hirta include its potential to help with wound healing, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
